stemMd: A neutral atom has atomic number 17 and mass number 37. How many neutrons does it contain?
explanationMd: Mass number equals protons plus neutrons. Subtract the atomic number from 37: 37 minus 17 is 20. Neutrality determines electron count, not neutron count.

distractorRationale.d: This counts protons and neutrons together.
distractorRationale.b: This is not the difference between the given numbers.
